fb_rent_too_high_aebcfb_01.desc: Should the federal government do more to increase the supply of affordable housing? What do you think?

fb_rent_too_high_aebcfb_02.desc: Why is it so difficult for working families to find housing they can actually afford? What do you think?

fb_rent_too_high_aebcfb_03.desc: Should cities make it easier to build apartments and other high-density housing? What do you think?

fb_rent_too_high_aebcfb_04.desc: Would building more homes help slow the growth of rents? What do you think?

fb_rent_too_high_aebcfb_05.desc: Should governments provide more funding for affordable housing construction? What do you think?

fb_rent_too_high_aebcfb_06.desc: Is the shortage of housing a bigger problem than rising demand in explaining high rents? What do you think?

fb_rent_too_high_aebcfb_07.desc: Should zoning rules be changed to allow more apartments near jobs and public transportation? What do you think?

fb_rent_too_high_aebcfb_08.desc: Would expanding housing vouchers be more effective than building new affordable housing? What do you think?

fb_rent_too_high_aebcfb_09.desc: Should developers receive tax incentives for constructing below-market rental units? What do you think?

fb_rent_too_high_aebcfb_10.desc: How much affordable housing should cities be required to include in new developments? What do you think?

fb_rent_too_high_aebcfb_11.desc: Should vacant properties be converted into affordable rental housing? What do you think?

fb_rent_too_high_aebcfb_12.desc: Would allowing more accessory dwelling units help increase the supply of affordable homes? What do you think?

fb_rent_too_high_aebcfb_13.desc: Should federal housing programs focus more on renters who spend a large share of their income on rent? What do you think?

fb_rent_too_high_aebcfb_14.desc: Can rent control solve housing affordability problems, or does the country need to build more homes? What do you think?

fb_rent_too_high_aebcfb_15.desc: Should local governments reduce regulations that make apartment construction expensive and slow? What do you think?

fb_rent_too_high_aebcfb_16.desc: Would more public housing reduce pressure on private rental markets? What do you think?

fb_rent_too_high_aebcfb_17.desc: Should affordable housing be built near major employment centers rather than pushed to distant suburbs? What do you think?

fb_rent_too_high_aebcfb_18.desc: Why are people expected to spend so much of their income on housing just to live near work? What do you think?

fb_rent_too_high_aebcfb_19.desc: Should governments prioritize housing construction even when existing residents oppose new development? What do you think?

fb_rent_too_high_aebcfb_20.desc: Would a national affordable housing investment help communities where rents have risen much faster than wages? What do you think?
